package main

// Generator of go-oracle.json: what the frozen Go toolsetupdate says with
// recorded registry answers. The Go code is frozen, so this is kept as text.
// To regenerate at the freeze commit: copy it to
// dev/toolsetupdate/zz_oracle_test.go, run
// go test -count=1 -run TestZZOracle ./dev/toolsetupdate, delete the copy.
//
// Every request of the command goes to one fake server, whatever host it
// names (registry-1.docker.io, ghcr.io, auth.example.test, get.helm.sh,
// raw.githubusercontent.com): a manifest path answers with a recorded index
// from testdata after a bearer-token round, a .sha256sum path with the
// SHA-256 of "archive <path>", and any other path with "content of <path>".
// The TypeScript test serves the same answers.

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// fakeAnswers configures the fake server.
type fakeAnswers struct {
	// manifests maps a manifest path to a testdata file; others get
	// index-alpine.json.
	manifests map[string]string
	// challenge replaces the WWW-Authenticate header of the 401 answer.
	challenge string
	// token is the body of the token answer; tokenStatus its status.
	token       string
	tokenStatus int
	// noAuth serves manifests without a token round.
	noAuth bool
}

func fakeServer(t *testing.T, a fakeAnswers) *http.Client {
	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		p := r.URL.Path
		switch {
		case p == "/token":
			if a.tokenStatus != 0 {
				w.WriteHeader(a.tokenStatus)
			}
			if !strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Query().Get("scope"), "repository:") {
				http.Error(w, "bad scope", http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			body := a.token
			if body == "" {
				body = `{"token":"anon"}`
			}
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(body))
		case strings.Contains(p, "/manifests/"):
			if !a.noAuth && r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer anon" {
				challenge := a.challenge
				if challenge == "" {
					challenge = `Bearer realm="https://auth.example.test/token",service="fake"`
				}
				w.Header().Set("WWW-Authenticate", challenge)
				http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
				return
			}
			file, ok := a.manifests[p]
			if !ok {
				file = "testdata/index-alpine.json"
			}
			if file == "" {
				http.NotFound(w, r)
				return
			}
			body, err := os.ReadFile(file)
			if err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
			_, _ = w.Write(body)
		case strings.HasSuffix(p, ".missing.sha256sum") || strings.HasSuffix(p, "/missing.json"):
			http.NotFound(w, r)
		case strings.HasSuffix(p, ".html.sha256sum"):
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte("<html>moved</html>\n"))
		case strings.HasSuffix(p, ".sha256sum"):
			sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte("archive " + p))
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) + "  " + path.Base(strings.TrimSuffix(p, ".sha256sum")) + "\n"))
		default:
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte("content of " + p))
		}
	}))
	t.Cleanup(srv.Close)
	to, _ := url.Parse(srv.URL)
	return &http.Client{Transport: rewrite{to: to, base: srv.Client().Transport}}
}

// rewrite sends every request to the fake server, keeping its path.
type rewrite struct {
	to   *url.URL
	base http.RoundTripper
}

func (r rewrite) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	req = req.Clone(req.Context())
	req.URL.Scheme, req.URL.Host = r.to.Scheme, r.to.Host
	return r.base.RoundTrip(req)
}

type runCase struct {
	Name     string            `json:"name"`
	Args     []string          `json:"args"`
	Refused  map[string]string `json:"manifests"`
	ExitCode int               `json:"exitCode"`
	Stdout   string            `json:"stdout"`
	Stderr   string            `json:"stderr"`
}

type lookupCase struct {
	Name   string `json:"name"`
	Kind   string `json:"kind"` // "image", "checksum", "file"
	Repo   string `json:"repo,omitempty"`
	Tag    string `json:"tag,omitempty"`
	URL    string `json:"url,omitempty"`
	Answer struct {
		Manifests   map[string]string `json:"manifests,omitempty"`
		Challenge   string            `json:"challenge,omitempty"`
		Token       string            `json:"token,omitempty"`
		TokenStatus int               `json:"tokenStatus,omitempty"`
		NoAuth      bool              `json:"noAuth,omitempty"`
	} `json:"answer"`
	Result string `json:"result"`
	Err    string `json:"err"`
}

func TestZZOracle(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	table := "../../internal/toolset"

	var runs []runCase
	for _, c := range []runCase{
		{Name: "dry run of the real table", Args: []string{"-dry-run", "-dir", table}},
		{Name: "dry run with refused images", Args: []string{"-dry-run", "-dir", table}, Refused: map[string]string{
			"/v2/library/node/manifests/24.22.1":      "testdata/index-alpine-without-arm64.json",
			"/v2/hadolint/hadolint/manifests/v2.15.1": "testdata/single-manifest.json",
		}},
		{Name: "an unknown flag", Args: []string{"-x"}},
		{Name: "help", Args: []string{"-h"}},
		{Name: "a flag without its value", Args: []string{"-dir"}},
		{Name: "a bad boolean", Args: []string{"-dry-run=nope"}},
		{Name: "a folder without a table", Args: []string{"-dir", "testdata"}},
		{Name: "a folder that does not exist", Args: []string{"-dir", "testdata/nothing-here"}},
	} {
		client := fakeServer(t, fakeAnswers{manifests: c.Refused})
		src := liveSources{&Registry{HTTP: client}, &ReleaseServer{HTTP: client}}
		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
		c.ExitCode = run(ctx, c.Args, &stdout, &stderr, src)
		c.Stdout, c.Stderr = stdout.String(), stderr.String()
		runs = append(runs, c)
	}

	var lookups []lookupCase
	add := func(c lookupCase) {
		client := fakeServer(t, fakeAnswers{manifests: c.Answer.Manifests, challenge: c.Answer.Challenge,
			token: c.Answer.Token, tokenStatus: c.Answer.TokenStatus, noAuth: c.Answer.NoAuth})
		var res string
		var err error
		switch c.Kind {
		case "image":
			res, err = (&Registry{HTTP: client}).IndexDigest(ctx, c.Repo, c.Tag)
		case "checksum":
			res, err = (&ReleaseServer{HTTP: client}).Checksum(ctx, c.URL)
		case "file":
			res, err = (&ReleaseServer{HTTP: client}).FileChecksum(ctx, c.URL)
		}
		c.Result = res
		if err != nil {
			c.Err = err.Error()
		}
		lookups = append(lookups, c)
	}
	img := func(name, repo, tag string) lookupCase {
		return lookupCase{Name: name, Kind: "image", Repo: repo, Tag: tag}
	}
	c := img("a multi-arch index", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	add(c)
	c = img("an index without arm64", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.Manifests = map[string]string{"/v2/library/alpine/manifests/3.24.3": "testdata/index-alpine-without-arm64.json"}
	add(c)
	c = img("a single manifest", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.Manifests = map[string]string{"/v2/library/alpine/manifests/3.24.3": "testdata/single-manifest.json"}
	add(c)
	c = img("a manifest that is not JSON", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.Manifests = map[string]string{"/v2/library/alpine/manifests/3.24.3": "testdata/go-oracle.go.txt"}
	add(c)
	c = img("a missing tag", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.Manifests = map[string]string{"/v2/library/alpine/manifests/3.24.3": ""}
	add(c)
	add(img("a GitHub registry image", "ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks", "v8.30.1"))
	add(img("a tag that needs escaping", "vendor/tool", "v1+build"))
	c = img("without a token round", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.NoAuth = true
	add(c)
	c = img("a Basic challenge", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.Challenge = `Basic realm="registry"`
	add(c)
	c = img("a challenge without a realm", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.Challenge = `Bearer service="fake"`
	add(c)
	c = img("a token endpoint that fails", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.TokenStatus = http.StatusInternalServerError
	add(c)
	c = img("a token endpoint without a token", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.Token = `{}`
	add(c)
	c = img("an access token", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.Token = `{"access_token":"anon"}`
	add(c)
	c = img("a token that is not accepted", "alpine", "3.24.3")
	c.Answer.Token = `{"token":"wrong"}`
	add(c)
	add(lookupCase{Name: "a release checksum", Kind: "checksum", URL: "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v3.22.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz"})
	add(lookupCase{Name: "a missing release checksum", Kind: "checksum", URL: "https://get.helm.sh/a.missing"})
	add(lookupCase{Name: "a release checksum that is not a SHA-256", Kind: "checksum", URL: "https://get.helm.sh/moved.html"})
	add(lookupCase{Name: "a plain file", Kind: "file", URL: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/x/pod-v1.json"})
	add(lookupCase{Name: "a missing plain file", Kind: "file", URL: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/x/missing.json"})

	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8",
		"runs":         runs,
		"lookups":      lookups,
	}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/go-oracle.json", append(out, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
